calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for KBRA
calls.summary: KBRA is transitioning to a data-driven culture by initiating A/B testing to improve product decisions and speed up market launches. Larry Latour leads the effort, emphasizing the need to replace internal opinions with data-backed decisions to enhance conversions, particularly for lead generation rather than direct sales. GrowthBook was identified as a potential experimentation platform that aligns with KBRA's technical and data privacy requirements, especially concerning EU regulations. The platform's capabilities include feature flagging and support for both front-end and back-end technologies, which facilitate efficient experimentation. KBRA is also considering flexible pricing models to start small and validate ROI before committing fully. The next steps include scheduling proofs of concept and demos to assess the platform's fit.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Self-Hosting, EU Compliance, Experimentation Platform, Conversion Optimization

calls.title: KBRA & Growthbook Technical Demo
calls.summary: The team discussed a strategy to begin with a Pro-level subscription to validate the product's value prior to considering larger enterprise licenses. They aimed for a structured proof of concept (POC) involving targeted tests over a month, with an emphasis on balancing financial and engineering efforts in the decision-making process. Key discussions included the integration of feature flags and experimentation tools, potential measurable impacts, and the necessity of open communication with vendors. The launch of the POC is targeted for the end of Q2, focusing on high-traffic projects to demonstrate business value earlier and ensure internal buy-in.
calls.keywords: Feature flags, Experimentation, Proof of concept, Snowflake integration, GDPR compliance, AI analytics
